question.problem:
What is the radius $r$ of a circle with a circumference of $C=17\pi?$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14183030/assets/697cc9ca06bcfe46d84dfab74e0f6ae83f4342607ea4af138b111606c16e8a03.png)
question.worked_solution:
We use the formula for the circumference $C=2\pi r$ and solve for $r.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}C & =2\pi r \\ 17\pi  & =2\pi r \\ r & =\frac{17\pi }{2\pi } \\  & =\frac{17}{2} \\  & =8.5.\end{aligned}
$$
